sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The ❌ and ⚠️ lists of problems start with All errors / All warnings: one click shows every row with a problem of that kind in any column (two single rows in different columns show only rows with both). Its number counts rows; while it is on, the single rows are greyed, a chip beside the global filter has a ✕ to remove it, and All errors with All warnings together show rows with both. On every page, MusicBrainz and Brucebase alike; on Brucebase it is BruceBaseParser's "only the mismatches" view.
